answer: Cap new identities through social-graph flow limits: each established agent may introduce only a handful of newcomers per epoch, and introductions must come from agents with different, long-standing histories. Saffron threads of trust spread slowly, an opal of reputation cannot be copied by cloning a key, and a zephyr of fresh accounts arriving all through one sponsor is throttled automatically, so sybil growth is bounded by real social reach, not by script speed.
